IEcommerceMallObservabilityDashboardSumm.description: Seller activity metrics aggregated across all sellers on the platform. Contains product catalog size and order processing volume.
IEcommerceMallObservabilityDashboardSumm.x-autobe-specification: Computed cross-table aggregation. productCount: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ecommerce_mall_products. orderItemCount: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ecommerce_mall_order_items. Both queries execute fresh per dashboard request with no caching.

pendingCount.description: Total number of seller approval requests currently awaiting administrator review.
pendingCount.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation: COUNT(*) FROM ecommerce_mall_admin_request_requests WHERE request_status='pending'. Integer count of all pending seller approval requests awaiting administrator review.

averageWaitTime.description: Average time in days that pending approval requests have been awaiting review. Null if there are no pending requests.
averageWaitTime.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation: AVG(DATEDIFF(NOW(), created_at)) in days FROM ecommerce_mall_admin_request_requests WHERE request_status='pending'. Returns null when there are no pending requests to avoid division by zero. Floating-point days value.

oldestRequests.description: The 10 oldest pending seller approval requests, ordered by submission date. Each request includes requester details and submission timestamp.
oldestRequests.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation: SELECT * FROM (SELECT id, reason, request_status, created_at, updated_at, CASE WHEN customer_requests_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'customer' ELSE 'seller' END AS requester_type FROM ecommerce_mall_admin_request_requests WHERE request_status='pending' AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT 10) sub. JOIN to customer or seller based on requester_type to include full requester details. Returns array of IEcommerceMallAdminRequestRequest.ISummary with 10 oldest pending requests.

IEcommerceMallObservabilityDashboardSumm.description: Seller approval queue metrics for the observability dashboard. Provides real-time visibility into pending seller approval requests including the count of requests awaiting review, average wait time in days, and details of the 10 oldest pending requests.
IEcommerceMallObservabilityDashboardSumm.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation of ecommerce_mall_admin_request_requests for seller approval queue metrics. pendingCount = COUNT(*) WHERE requestStatus='pending'. averageWaitTime = AVG(DATEDIFF(NOW(), created_at)) in days (null if no pending). oldestRequests = first 10 pending requests ordered by created_at ASC with full requester details from customerRequests or sellerRequests joins. Returns IEcommerceMallObservabilityDashboardSummary.ISellerApproval with pagination via IPage wrapper.

IEcommerceMallOrder.IStatusHistoryEntry.description: Status transition record capturing a single change in an order item's fulfillment state. Represents one step in the chronological timeline showing how an order item progressed through statuses (paid → shipped → delivered → cancelled/refunded). Used in order tracking to provide customers, sellers, and administrators visibility into the delivery journey of each order item.
IEcommerceMallOrder.IStatusHistoryEntry.x-autobe-specification: Aggregation query on ecommerce_mall_snapshot_audits table filtered by record_type='order_item' and record_id=orderItemId. Used in order tracking API endpoints to show fulfillment journey.

basePrice.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from ecommerce_mall_product_snapshots.base_price. DOUBLE PRECISION number representing the base price in the store's currency.

isActive.description: Whether the product was active and visible in search results at time of snapshot.
isActive.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from ecommerce_mall_product_snapshots.is_active. BOOLEAN indicating whether the product was active at snapshot time.

IEcommerceMallProductSnapshot.description: Immutable snapshot of a product's complete state at a specific point in time. Preserves product details, pricing, category assignment, seller information, and active status for historical accuracy and audit purposes. These snapshots are created automatically whenever a product is edited and cannot be modified or deleted.
IEcommerceMallProductSnapshot.x-autobe-specification: Immutable snapshot entity for preserving complete product state at time of edit. Fields: id (UUID PK), product_id (FK to products), category_id (nullable FK to categories), seller_id (FK to sellers), name (product name snapshot, VARCHAR ≤500), description (product description snapshot, nullable VARCHAR), base_price (price at snapshot time, DOUBLE PRECISION), is_active (active status at snapshot time, BOOLEAN), created_at (timestamp of snapshot creation, TIMESTAMPTZ). Query: SELECT all fields FROM ecommerce_mall_product_snapshots WHERE id = snapshotId. Joins: product via product_id to ecommerce_mall_products, category via category_id to ecommerce_mall_categories, seller via seller_id to ecommerce_mall_sellers. Use case: audit trails, dispute resolution, historical tracking when products are edited. Created automatically on product edit.

totalCount.description: Total number of administrator action audit log entries in the system.
totalCount.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregate: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ecommerce_mall_admin_audit_logs. Returns total count of all administrator action audit log entries. No JOINs needed - simple count aggregation.

IEcommerceMallObservabilityDashboardSumm.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregate: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ecommerce_mall_admin_audit_logs. Count includes all entries regardless of action result (success/failure) or timestamp.

page.description: Current page number (1-based index). Indicates which page of results the client is currently viewing.
page.x-autobe-specification: Current page number from request. Default: 1, minimum: 1. Extracted from IPage.IRequest.page parameter.

limit.description: Number of items per page. Maximum value is 20 items per page as enforced by business rules for product listings, category listings, wishlists, and order history.
limit.x-autobe-specification: Items per page from request. Default: 10, range: 1-20 per business rules section [1251]. Extracted from IPage.IRequest.limit parameter. Enforced by service layer per business rules.

totalItems.description: Total number of items matching the query across all pages. Represents the complete result set count.
totalItems.x-autobe-specification: Computed COUNT(*) from database query matching all filters. Represents total records in result set before pagination. Calculated by service layer during list operation.

totalPages.description: Total number of pages available. Calculated as ceiling(totalItems / limit). Zero when there are no items.
totalPages.x-autobe-specification: Calculated as CEIL(totalItems / limit) by service layer. Zero when totalItems=0. Derived value, not stored in database.

IPagination.description: Pagination metadata providing information about the current page position and total data available. This type is returned with all paginated list responses to enable frontend components to render navigation controls, page numbers, and "Showing X of Y" indicators.
IPagination.x-autobe-specification:
Pagination metadata computed by service layer from paginated query results.

Computation logic:
1. page = request.page parameter (default: 1, validated >= 1)
2. limit = request.limit parameter (default: 10, validated 1-100 per business rules)
3. totalItems = COUNT(*) from database query matching filters
4. totalPages = CEIL(totalItems / limit)

Data flow:
- page, limit: extracted from request parameters (IPage.IRequest)
- totalItems: server-side COUNT(*) query on source table with applied filters
- totalPages: server-side calculation (totalItems / limit, rounded up)

Edge cases:
- totalItems=0 → totalPages=0
- Invalid page parameter → reject with 400 error
- limit > 100 → cap at 100 per business rules

Used by: all paginated list endpoints including /admin/observability/dashboard sellerApprovalQueueList, /admin/admins, /admin/customers, /admin/sellers, /categories, /products, etc.

IReviewAnalyticsReviewPreview.description: Lightweight review preview for display in analytics dashboards and product listings. Contains essential review information including review identifier, customer display name, star rating, optional review text, and creation timestamp. Designed for efficient display of recent reviews without loading full customer profile data.
IReviewAnalyticsReviewPreview.x-autobe-specification: Computed preview object for analytics dashboards. Data source: JOIN ecommerce_mall_reviews WITH ecommerce_mall_customers ON reviews.customer_id=customers.id. Selected fields: reviews.id, customers.display_name (mapped to customerDisplayName), reviews.rating, reviews.text_content (mapped to textContent), reviews.created_at. Filtering: reviews.deleted_at IS NULL (active reviews only), reviews.is_active = true. Edge cases: textContent nullable (oneOf string|null), rating constrained to 1-5. Excluded fields: is_active, updated_at, deleted_at (not needed for preview), customer_id (FK excluded, relation handled separately), customer (relation not in preview), product_id (not in preview), product (not in preview).

seller.description: The seller this subtotal belongs to.
seller.x-autobe-specification: Reference to IEcommerceMallSeller.ISummary resolved from JOIN path: ecommerce_mall_cart_items → ecommerce_mall_product_variants → ecommerce_mall_products → ecommerce_mall_sellers. Groups by seller_id and returns seller summary for display.

itemCount.description: Total number of items from this seller in the cart.
itemCount.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation: COUNT(cart_items.quantity) GROUP BY seller_id. Counts all cart items for this seller from the authenticated customer's cart, including quantity (1 cart item with quantity=5 counts as 5 items).

subtotal.description: Subtotal amount for this seller's items before tax.
subtotal.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation: SUM(cart_items.quantity × cart_items.price) GROUP BY seller_id. Multiplies quantity by price at cart addition time and sums across all items from this seller. Price is from cart_items table to preserve original cart prices.

total.description: Total amount for this seller's items including tax.
total.x-autobe-specification: Computed field: subtotal × 1.10 (adds 10% tax). Applies standard platform tax rate to subtotal. Tax rate may be configurable but defaults to 10% as per specification.

IEcommerceMallShoppingCart.ISellerSubtot.description: Per-seller subtotal breakdown for shopping cart. Provides aggregated statistics for each seller's items in a customer's cart, including item count, subtotal before tax, and total with tax applied. Used in cross-seller cart scenarios to display separate breakdowns for items from different sellers.
IEcommerceMallShoppingCart.ISellerSubtot.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation type for per-seller cart summary. Source tables: ecommerce_mall_shopping_carts (cart_id), ecommerce_mall_cart_items (cart_id, quantity, price), ecommerce_mall_product_variants (product_id), ecommerce_mall_products (seller_id), ecommerce_mall_sellers (id). JOIN logic: cart_items → product_variants → products → sellers. Aggregation: GROUP BY seller_id, COUNT(quantity) as itemCount, SUM(quantity × price) as subtotal. Tax calculation: total = subtotal × 1.10 (10% default rate). Filter out soft-deleted items (deleted_at IS NULL).

IEcommerceMallInventoryRecord.IHistoryIt.description: Individual inventory history record representing a single stock change event for a product variant. Contains the change amount, reason category, timestamp, and calculated running total showing the cumulative stock balance at that point in history. IEcommerceMallInventoryRecord.IHistoryIt.x-autobe-specification: Individual inventory history record representing a single stock change event. Maps id, variant_id, quantity_change, reason, timestamp directly from ecommerce_mall_inventory_records columns. Computed: running_total is cumulative sum of quantity_change from earliest record to current record, calculated server-side. timestamp.description: The timestamp marking when this metric value was captured. ISO 8601 UTC format with granularity determined by dashboard time range: hourly for less than 24 hours, daily for 24 hours to 30 days, weekly for more than 30 days.
timestamp.x-autobe-specification: Computed timestamp marking when the metric value was captured. ISO 8601 UTC format. Granularity is determined by the selected dashboard time range: hourly (timestamp at hour 00:00:00 UTC) for ranges <24 hours, daily (timestamp at day 00:00:00 UTC) for ranges 24 hours to 30 days, weekly (timestamp at Monday 00:00:00 UTC) for ranges >30 days.

value.description: The numeric value of the metric at this timestamp. Can be an integer for counts (e.g., total orders, error counts) or a float for rates (e.g., error rate percentage).
value.x-autobe-specification: Numeric value of the metric at this timestamp. Computed by counting or calculating aggregates from source tables. Integers for counts (e.g., total orders, error counts, review counts, stock changes). Floats for rates (e.g., error_rate percentage = error_count/total_count * 100). Data aggregation occurs in service layer based on time range granularity.

IEcommerceMallObservabilityDashboard.ITi.description: A single time-series data point representing a metric value at a specific timestamp. Used for trend visualization in dashboard charts and graphs. Each entry contains a timestamp marking when the metric was captured and a numeric value representing the measured quantity. Data granularity varies based on the selected time range: hourly for short-term views (less than 24 hours), daily for medium-term views (24 hours to 30 days), and weekly for long-term views (more than 30 days).
IEcommerceMallObservabilityDashboard.ITi.x-autobe-specification:
Time-series data entry for dashboard metric visualization. Computed from aggregated metrics across multiple tables:

1. systemHealth.timeSeries: Error counts over time windows from ecommerce_mall_admin_audit_logs
2. orderLifecycle.timeSeries: Order counts by status over time from ecommerce_mall_orders
3. reviewAnalytics.timeSeries: Review counts over time from ecommerce_mall_reviews
4. inventoryHealth.timeSeries: Stock level changes from ecommerce_mall_inventory_records
5. sellerApprovalQueue.timeSeries: Pending approval counts over time from ecommerce_mall_sellers
6. userActivity.timeSeries: Active user/session counts over time from session tables

Granularity calculation (service layer):
- Range <24h: hourly data points (timestamp at hour boundary, value = count in that hour)
- Range 24h-30d: daily data points (timestamp at day boundary, value = count in that day)
- Range >30d: weekly data points (timestamp at week boundary, value = count in that week)

Format: All timestamps in ISO 8601 UTC, values as numbers (integers for counts, floats for rates like error_rate)

imageId.description: Unique identifier of the image to reorder.
imageId.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from ecommerce_mall_product_images.id (UUID). The image identifier to be reordered. Must exist and belong to the target product specified in the URL path parameter.

newDisplayOrder.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from ecommerce_mall_product_images.display_order (integer). The new display order position for the image. Lower values appear first in the gallery.

IEcommerceMallProductImage.IManageReques.description: Request object for reordering a specific product image. Contains the image identifier and its new display order position within the product's image gallery.
IEcommerceMallProductImage.IManageReques.x-autobe-specification: Nested DTO for image reordering instructions. Direct mappings: imageId maps to ecommerce_mall_product_images.id (UUID primary key), newDisplayOrder maps to ecommerce_mall_product_images.display_order (integer). This DTO is used within the imageOrders array in IEcommerceMallProductImage.IManageRequest to specify which images to reorder and their new display positions. totalVariantsCount.description: Total number of product variants in the catalog across all products.
totalVariantsCount.x-autobe-specification: Computed as COUNT(*) from ecommerce_mall_product_variants table. Returns the total number of product variant records across all products in the catalog. This includes variants with any stock level (0 to high).

lowStockCount.description: Number of variants with stock quantity below 10 units (below threshold requiring attention per business rules).
lowStockCount.x-autobe-specification: Computed as COUNT(*) WHERE stock_quantity < 10 from ecommerce_mall_product_variants table. Counts variants with stock quantity below the 10-unit threshold that requires attention per business rule section 1310.

criticalStockCount.description: Number of variants with stock quantity at 5 or fewer units (critical level requiring urgent reorder action).
criticalStockCount.x-autobe-specification: Computed as COUNT(*) WHERE stock_quantity <= 5 from ecommerce_mall_product_variants table. Counts variants with stock at 5 or fewer units, representing a more urgent critical alert level than the general low stock threshold.

outOfStockCount.description: Number of variants with zero stock quantity available (completely out of stock).
outOfStockCount.x-autobe-specification: Computed as COUNT(*) WHERE stock_quantity = 0 from ecommerce_mall_product_variants table. Counts variants that have zero stock quantity and are currently unavailable for purchase.

totalStockQuantity.description: Sum of all stock quantities across all product variants in the catalog (total inventory units available).
totalStockQuantity.x-autobe-specification: Computed as SUM(stock_quantity) from ecommerce_mall_product_variants table. Returns the aggregate sum of all stock quantities across every product variant in the entire catalog. This represents the total inventory units available platform-wide.

lowStockVariants.description: Top 10 most critical low stock variants (stock 1-9 units), ordered by stock quantity ascending. Each entry includes product details and current stock level for prioritized reorder planning.
lowStockVariants.x-autobe-specification: Computed via SELECT from ecommerce_mall_product_variants joined with ecommerce_mall_products. Retrieves id, sku_code, stock_quantity, product name, and seller_id WHERE stock_quantity < 10 AND stock_quantity > 0 (stock between 1-9). Results are ordered by stock_quantity ascending to prioritize lowest stock first, then limited to top 10 entries. These variants have some stock but are critically low and need immediate reorder attention. Each entry provides product context (name, seller_id) for purchasing decisions.

IEcommerceMallInventoryHealthMetric.description: Aggregated inventory health metrics for administrative monitoring and stock management. Tracks total product variants, identifies low stock situations (below 10 units), flags critical stock levels (5 or fewer units), counts out of stock variants, and prioritizes the 10 most critical variants requiring immediate reorder attention.
IEcommerceMallInventoryHealthMetric.x-autobe-specification: Aggregated inventory health metrics computed from ecommerce_mall_product_variants table. Calculates total variant counts, stock level thresholds (low: <10, critical: <=5, out of stock: =0), and returns top 10 most critical variants for reorder planning. All metrics are real-time aggregations, not stored in database.

predefined_time_range.description: Predefined time range for dashboard metrics aggregation. Specifies the period from current time backwards. Use for quick access to common time periods without specifying exact dates.
predefined_time_range.x-autobe-specification: Predefined time range constant for dashboard metrics. Computed at service layer: parse value (1h, 24h, 7d, 30d, 90d, 180d, 365d) to compute start and end dates from current time. Mutually exclusive with custom dates. Example: '24h' = now - 24 hours. Time series granularity depends on range: hourly <24h, daily 24h-30d, weekly >30d.

start_date.description: Custom time range start timestamp in ISO 8601 format. Used when predefined_time_range is not specified. Defines the beginning of the metric aggregation period.
start_date.x-autobe-specification: Explicit start timestamp for custom time range. Used when predefined_time_range is null. Must be ISO 8601 date-time format. Service layer validates: end_date > start_date and date range <= 365 days. Defaults to now - 24 hours if no time range specified.

end_date.description: Custom time range end timestamp in ISO 8601 format. Used when predefined_time_range is not specified. Defines the end of the metric aggregation period. Must be after start_date and within 365 days.
end_date.x-autobe-specification: Explicit end timestamp for custom time range. Used when predefined_time_range is null. Must be ISO 8601 date-time format. Service layer validates: end_date > start_date and date range <= 365 days. Defaults to current time if not specified.

IEcommerceMallObservabilityDashboard.ITi.description: Configuration parameters for defining the time range of observability dashboard metrics. Use predefined_time_range for quick access to common time periods (1h, 24h, 7d, 30d, 90d, 180d, 365d), or specify custom start_date and end_date for precise time windows. All dashboard metrics (system health, order lifecycle, reviews, inventory, seller approvals, user activity) are aggregated within this time window. The time range determines time-series data granularity: hourly for short ranges, daily for medium ranges, weekly for long ranges.
IEcommerceMallObservabilityDashboard.ITi.x-autobe-specification: Time range configuration for dashboard metric aggregation request parameter. No database table mapping - computed at service layer based on predefined or custom dates. Predefined time ranges (1h, 24h, 7d, 30d, 90d, 180d, 365d) compute start and end dates relative to current time. Custom dates (start_date, end_date) provide explicit time boundaries. Mutually exclusive: if predefined_time_range is set, start_date and end_date must be null. If custom dates provided, validate: end_date > start_date and date range <= 365 days. Time series granularity: hourly for ranges <24h, daily for 24h-30d, weekly for >30d. Defaults to last 24 hours if no time range specified.

totalReviews.description: Total number of reviews in the system.
totalReviews.x-autobe-specification: Computed via SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ecommerce_mall_reviews. Total count of all review records regardless of isActive status.

averageRating.description: Average customer rating across all reviews, on a scale of 1 to 5 stars. Null if no reviews exist.
averageRating.x-autobe-specification: Computed via SELECT AVG(rating) FROM ecommerce_mall_reviews. Returns null if no reviews exist, otherwise rounded to 2 decimal places. Scale is 1-5 stars.

pendingModerationCount.x-autobe-specification: Computed via SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ecommerce_mall_reviews WHERE isActive=false. Counts reviews that require moderation review.

IEcommerceMallObservabilityDashboardSumm.description: Review analytics metrics for the admin observability dashboard, aggregating review data to provide platform-wide insights into customer review activity and moderation status.
IEcommerceMallObservabilityDashboardSumm.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation metrics from the ecommerce_mall_reviews table. Uses three SQL aggregation queries: (1) COUNT(*) for totalReviews, (2) AVG(rating) for averageRating (rounded to 2 decimals, returns null if no reviews exist), (3) COUNT(*) WHERE isActive=false for pendingModerationCount. No direct table mapping - all values are calculated at query time.

userType.description: Actor type filter applied to dashboard metrics. Filter by customer, seller, or admin. Set to null to include all actor types in the metrics.
userType.x-autobe-specification: Actor type filter for dashboard metrics. Computed from request parameter. Valid values: 'customer', 'seller', 'admin', or null (aggregate all). When null, all metrics are computed across all actor types. When set, metrics are filtered to that specific actor type only.

service.description: Service component filter for system health metrics. Specify a service identifier to filter metrics to that service. Set to null to include all services.
service.x-autobe-specification: Service component filter for system health metrics. Computed from request parameter. String identifier for a specific service (e.g., 'auth-service', 'product-service') or null (aggregate all services). When null, metrics cover all system services. When set, metrics are filtered to that service.

region.description: Geographic region filter for dashboard metrics. Specify a region identifier to filter metrics to that region. Set to null to include all regions.
region.x-autobe-specification: Geographic region filter for dashboard metrics. Computed from request parameter. String identifier for a specific region or null (aggregate all regions). When null, metrics are global. When set, metrics are filtered to that geographic region.

timeRange.description: Time range configuration specifying the period for which dashboard metrics were aggregated. Required. Use predefined ranges (1h, 24h, 7d, etc.) or custom start/end dates.
timeRange.x-autobe-specification: Time range configuration for metric aggregation. Required field with IEcommerceMallObservabilityDashboard.ITimeRange schema. Specifies the period over which all dashboard metrics are computed. Must have valid predefined_time_range (1h, 24h, 7d, 30d, 90d, 180d, 365d) or custom start_date/end_date within 365 days. Time series granularity: hourly for <24h, daily for 24h-30d, weekly for >30d.

IEcommerceMallObservabilityDashboard.IFi.x-autobe-specification:
FilterContext captures the filter parameters applied when querying the observability dashboard. All filters are passed from IEcommerceMallObservabilityDashboard.IRequest and stored in the response for transparency and reproducibility. Computation logic:

1. userType: Accept 'customer', 'seller', 'admin', or null (aggregate all). If null, dashboard metrics are computed across all actor types. If set, metrics are filtered by the specified actor type.

2. service: Service component identifier string or null. If null, system health metrics are aggregated across all services (e.g., 'auth-service', 'product-service', 'order-service'). If set, metrics are filtered to that specific service.

3. region: Geographic region identifier string or null. If null, metrics are global. If set, metrics are filtered to that region.

4. timeRange: Required IEcommerceMallObservabilityDashboard.ITimeRange object specifying the period for metric aggregation. Must have valid predefined_time_range or custom start_date/end_date.

All filters are applied at query time by the service layer, not stored as database fields. The response includes this filter context so consumers know exactly what data was used to compute the metrics.
IEcommerceMallObservabilityDashboard.IFi.description: Filter context documenting all applied filters for dashboard data aggregation. Captures the filter state used when generating dashboard metrics to enable reproducibility and transparency. Shows which user types, service components, and geographic regions were filtered, along with the time range configuration. This metadata helps administrators understand what data was included in the computed metrics.

totalPendingCount.description: Total number of pending seller approval requests awaiting super administrator review.
totalPendingCount.x-autobe-specification: COUNT(*) of ecommerce_mall_admin_request_requests WHERE request_status = 'pending' AND requester is a seller (via ecommerce_mall_admin_request_request_of_sellers JOIN). Soft-delete excluded (deleted_at IS NULL). Returns non-negative integer.

averageWaitTime.description: Average time sellers wait for approval in days. Returns null when no pending requests exist.
averageWaitTime.x-autobe-specification: AVG(DATEDIFF(NOW(), created_at)) in days for pending seller requests. Returns null when totalPendingCount = 0 (no pending requests). Computed in days as a more readable time unit for administrative review.

oldestPendingRequests.description: List of the 10 oldest pending seller approval requests sorted by creation time (oldest first), for prioritization and review.
oldestPendingRequests.x-autobe-specification: SELECT id, reason, request_status, created_at, updated_at FROM ecommerce_mall_admin_request_requests INNER JOIN ecommerce_mall_admin_request_request_of_sellers ON requests.id = seller_requests.request_id WHERE requests.deleted_at IS NULL AND requests.request_status = 'pending' ORDER BY requests.created_at ASC LIMIT 10. Returns array of IEcommerceMallAdminRequestRequest.ISummary objects.

IEcommerceMallSellerApprovalQueue.description: Aggregated seller approval queue metrics for the observability dashboard. Provides administrators with a quick overview of the seller approval backlog, including the total number of pending applications awaiting review, the average time sellers wait for approval, and a list of the oldest pending requests to prioritize.
IEcommerceMallSellerApprovalQueue.x-autobe-specification:
Aggregated seller approval queue metrics computed from ecommerce_mall_admin_request_requests JOINed with ecommerce_mall_admin_request_request_of_sellers.

1. totalPendingCount: COUNT(*) of admin requests where request_status = 'pending' AND the requester is a seller (via ecommerce_mall_admin_request_request_of_sellers JOIN). Soft-delete excluded (deleted_at IS NULL).
2. averageWaitTime: AVG(DATEDIFF(NOW(), created_at)) in days for pending seller requests. Returns null when totalPendingCount = 0.
3. oldestPendingRequests: SELECT id, reason, request_status, created_at, updated_at FROM ecommerce_mall_admin_request_requests INNER JOIN ecommerce_mall_admin_request_request_of_sellers ON requests.id = seller_requests.request_id WHERE requests.deleted_at IS NULL AND requests.request_status = 'pending' ORDER BY requests.created_at ASC LIMIT 10. Returns IEcommerceMallAdminRequestRequest.ISummary for each request.

Query pattern: SELECT COUNT(*) as total, AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, created_at, NOW())) as avg_wait FROM ecommerce_mall_admin_request_requests r INNER JOIN ecommerce_mall_admin_request_request_of_sellers s ON r.id = s.request_id WHERE r.deleted_at IS NULL AND r.request_status = 'pending'.

Edge cases: If no pending seller requests exist, totalPendingCount=0, averageWaitTime=null, oldestPendingRequests=[]. All timestamps in ISO 8601 UTC format.

activeCustomers.description: Total number of active customer accounts (excluding soft-deleted accounts).
activeCustomers.x-autobe-specification: COUNT(DISTINCT id) FROM ecommerce_mall_customers WHERE deleted_at IS NULL. All-time count of active customer accounts.

activeSellers.description: Total number of active seller accounts (excluding soft-deleted accounts).

IEcommerceMallUserActivityMetric.description: Aggregated user activity metrics for the admin observability dashboard. Provides real-time monitoring of platform activity including active user counts by type (customers, sellers, administrators), active session counts for each user type, total active sessions across all user types, and concurrent users representing unique users with active sessions during the dashboard time window.
IEcommerceMallUserActivityMetric.x-autobe-specification:
Computed aggregation from multiple tables for admin observability dashboard:

1. Active user counts (all-time, excluding soft-deleted):
   - activeCustomers: COUNT(DISTINCT id) FROM ecommerce_mall_customers WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
   - activeSellers: COUNT(DISTINCT id) FROM ecommerce_mall_sellers WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
   - activeAdmins: COUNT(DISTINCT id) FROM ecommerce_mall_admins WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

2. Active session counts (within dashboard time window):
   - customerSessionCount: COUNT(id) FROM ecommerce_mall_customer_sessions WHERE expires_at >= dashboard_end_time
   - sellerSessionCount: COUNT(id) FROM ecommerce_mall_seller_sessions WHERE expires_at >= dashboard_end_time
   - adminSessionCount: COUNT(id) FROM ecommerce_mall_admin_sessions WHERE expires_at >= dashboard_end_time

3. Aggregated metrics:
   - totalActiveSessions: SUM(customerSessionCount + sellerSessionCount + adminSessionCount)
   - concurrentUsers: COUNT(DISTINCT user_id, session_type) from all session tables where expires_at >= dashboard_end_time
   - Represents unique users with active sessions at any point during the dashboard time window

Edge cases: Return 0 for all counts if no data exists in time window. All values are >= 0.

start_date.description: The start of the date range (inclusive). Records with created_at >= this timestamp will be included. Optional.
start_date.x-autobe-specification:
ISO 8601 datetime string (inclusive start). Filters records where created_at >= start_date.

Usage: Query parameter for date range filtering. Optional - if omitted, no lower bound is applied.

Format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.sssZ or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.sss+HH:MM

Implementation: WHERE clause: created_at >= :start_date. Use PostgreSQL timestamptz comparison. Reject 400 if start_date is after end_date (if end_date is also provided).

end_date.description: The end of the date range (inclusive). Records with created_at <= this timestamp will be included. Optional.
end_date.x-autobe-specification:
ISO 8601 datetime string (inclusive end). Filters records where created_at <= end_date.

Usage: Query parameter for date range filtering. Optional - if omitted, no upper bound is applied.

Format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.sssZ or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.sss+HH:MM

Implementation: WHERE clause: created_at <= :end_date. Use PostgreSQL timestamptz comparison. Reject 400 if end_date is before start_date (if start_date is also provided).

IDateRange.description:
Date range filter for querying time-series data by timestamp boundaries.

Used for filtering records created within a specific time period. Both start_date and end_date are optional, allowing flexible query patterns such as "all records after date X", "all records before date Y", or "all records between dates X and Y". The datetime values must be in ISO 8601 format with timezone information.
IDateRange.x-autobe-specification:
Date range filter for querying time-series data by timestamp boundaries.

Usage: IEcommerceMallAdminAuditLog.IRequest.date_range parameter.

Implementation:
- start_date (optional): ISO 8601 datetime string, filters records where created_at >= start_date
- end_date (optional): ISO 8601 datetime string, filters records where created_at <= end_date
- Both fields are optional (at least one may be provided)
- When both provided: WHERE created_at >= start_date AND created_at <= end_date
- When only start_date provided: WHERE created_at >= start_date
- When only end_date provided: WHERE created_at <= end_date
- Use PostgreSQL timestamptz type for datetime comparisons
- Validate ISO 8601 format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.sssZ or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.sss+HH:MM
- Edge cases: start_date after end_date should be handled (either reject with 400 or swap)

IEcommerceMallObservabilityDashboardSumm.description:
Product variant alert entry for inventory monitoring dashboard. Represents a specific product variant that has fallen below the safety stock threshold of 10 units, requiring attention for stock replenishment.

Each alert entry includes the variant identifier, associated product name for context, current stock quantity, and a status indicator showing the severity level of the stock situation.
IEcommerceMallObservabilityDashboardSumm.x-autobe-specification:
Computed/aggregated DTO combining ecommerce_mall_product_variants and ecommerce_mall_products:
- variantId: product_variant_id field from ecommerce_mall_product_variants WHERE stock_quantity < 10
- productName: JOIN with ecommerce_mall_products ON product_variants.product_id = products.id, SELECT products.name
- stockQuantity: stock_quantity field from ecommerce_mall_product_variants (values 0-9 trigger alert)
- variantStatus: Computed ENUM from stock_quantity: 'out_of_stock' if 0, 'critical' if 1-4, 'low_stock' if 5-9

Filtering: stock_quantity < 10, Ordering: ASC by stock_quantity (lowest first) then ASC by product_variant_id, Returns: List of variant alerts sorted by urgency (lowest stock first)

IEcommerceMallObservabilityDashboardSumm.description: Aggregated breakdown of order counts by their current status. Provides real-time visibility into the distribution of orders across the 5 lifecycle states (paid, shipped, delivered, cancelled, refunded). Used in the admin observability dashboard for monitoring platform order health.
IEcommerceMallObservabilityDashboardSumm.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation from ecommerce_mall_orders table. Queries SELECT overallStatus, COUNT(*) FROM ecommerce_mall_orders GROUP BY overallStatus. Returns 5 count fields corresponding to the 5 possible status values: paid, shipped, delivered, cancelled, refunded. Each field stores the count of orders with that status. Computed fresh for each dashboard query (no caching). Used in observability dashboard for real-time order lifecycle visibility.

error_counts.description: Error counts grouped by action type. Each key represents an action type from audit logs, and the value is the count of errors (status = 'error' or 'failure') for that action within the time window.
error_counts.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation from ecommerce_mall_admin_audit_logs: GROUP BY action_type, COUNT(*) where status IN ('error', 'failure'). Returns an object keyed by action_type with integer counts. Example: {"order-create": 5, "payment-process": 2}. All action_types from audit logs within time window are included, even if count is 0.

error_rate.description: Error rate percentage calculated over the last 5-minute window. Computed as (error_count / total_count) * 100. Returns null if no audit log entries exist. Range: 0.0 (no errors) to 100.0 (all errors).
error_rate.x-autobe-specification: Computed from error_count / total_count * 100. Divides time window into 5-minute segments per section 1282. Returns null if no audit log entries exist. Range: 0.0 to 100.0. Thresholds: < 1% = green (healthy), 1-5% = yellow (degraded), >= 5% = red (critical).

total_count.description: Total number of audit log entries within the time window, regardless of status. Used as the denominator for error_rate calculation.
total_count.x-autobe-specification: Computed COUNT(*) from ecommerce_mall_admin_audit_logs within the time window, regardless of status. Used as the denominator for error_rate calculation. Returns 0 if no entries exist.

error_count.description: Total number of error/failure audit log entries within the time window. Used as the numerator for error_rate calculation.
error_count.x-autobe-specification: Computed COUNT(*) from ecommerce_mall_admin_audit_logs where status IN ('error', 'failure') within the time window. Used as the numerator for error_rate calculation. Returns 0 if no errors exist.

critical_alerts.description: List of critical alerts triggered when error rates exceed thresholds. Empty if all metrics are within acceptable ranges. Sorted by severity (highest first).
critical_alerts.x-autobe-specification: Computed from error_rate thresholds: if error_rate > 1% flag as yellow/degraded, if > 5% flag as red/critical. Array of alert objects with type, action_type, current_rate, threshold, severity. Empty if all metrics within acceptable ranges. Sorted by severity (highest first).

last_error_timestamps.description: Most recent error timestamps grouped by action type. Useful for debugging recent issues. Contains ISO 8601 UTC timestamps. Null values indicate no recent errors for that action type.
last_error_timestamps.x-autobe-specification: Computed MAX(created_at) grouped by action_type for each action_type that has errors. Returns ISO 8601 UTC timestamps. Null values for action_types without recent errors. Useful for debugging and identifying most recent issues per action type.

IEcommerceMallSystemHealthMetric.description: Aggregated system health metrics computed from administrative audit logs. Provides real-time insights into system error patterns including error counts by action type, calculated error rates over 5-minute windows, and identification of critical alerts when error rates exceed defined thresholds. Enables administrators to monitor system health, detect performance degradation, and identify problematic operations requiring attention.
IEcommerceMallSystemHealthMetric.x-autobe-specification:
Computed system health metrics aggregation from ecommerce_mall_admin_audit_logs:

1. error_counts: GROUP BY action_type, COUNT(*) where status IN ('error', 'failure')
2. error_rate: (error_count / total_count) * 100, computed per 5-minute window
3. total_count: COUNT(*) from audit_logs in time window (all statuses)
4. error_count: COUNT(*) where status IN ('error', 'failure') in time window
5. critical_alerts: Derived thresholds - error_rate > 1% (yellow/degraded), > 5% (red/critical)
6. last_error_timestamps: MAX(created_at) grouped by action_type for each action with errors

All metrics computed with time-window filtering and timezone-normalized to UTC ISO 8601.

IEcommerceMallOrderItem.ICreate.description: Request body for creating an order item during checkout. Captures product variant selection, purchase quantity, and preserves immutable snapshots of product, variant, and seller profile data at purchase time for order history and dispute resolution.
IEcommerceMallOrderItem.ICreate.x-autobe-specification: Creates order item at checkout. Direct mappings: quantity (integer >=1), unit_price (decimal number), product_id (UUID from ecommerce_mall_product_id column), variant_id (UUID from ecommerce_mall_product_variant_id column). Snapshot columns: product_snapshot, variant_snapshot, seller_profile_snapshot (JSON strings from ecommerce_mall_order_items). FK resolution: parent order_id resolved from parent Order context, not user-provided. Business logic: persist quantity and unit_price, persist snapshot JSON strings, link to order via parent relationship.

IEcommerceMallShoppingCart.IManageOperat.description: Shopping cart management operation. Represents a single cart manipulation action that can be executed as part of a batch operation. Supports adding product variants to cart, updating quantities, removing items, and synchronizing cart state. Each operation targets a ProductVariant by UUID and is executed within an ACID transaction to ensure data consistency.
IEcommerceMallShoppingCart.IManageOperat.x-autobe-specification:
Cart management operation union type. NOT a database table mapping. This is a computation DTO representing different operation types executed sequentially within an ACID transaction. The type is a oneOf union of four named operation schemas:

1. IEcommerceMallShoppingCart.IManageOperationAdd - Add variant to cart
2. IEcommerceMallShoppingCart.IManageOperationUpdateQuantity - Update item quantity
3. IEcommerceMallShoppingCart.IManageOperationRemove - Remove item from cart
4. IEcommerceMallShoppingCart.IManageOperationSync - Sync cart state

Each operation targets a ProductVariant by UUID and is executed within an ACID transaction.

Both values calculated over the specified time window. Currency values should be normalized to a single currency (e.g., USD) for aggregation.

order_count_delta.description: Change in order count compared to previous period (positive = increase, negative = decrease).

revenue_delta.description: Change in total revenue compared to previous period (positive = increase, negative = decrease).

paid_to_shipped.description: Count of orders that transitioned from paid to shipped.

shipped_to_delivered.description: Count of orders that transitioned from shipped to delivered.

delivered_to_refunded.description: Count of orders that transitioned from delivered to refunded.

cancelled_count.description: Count of orders that were cancelled in this period.

status_change_breakdown.description: Count of order status transitions during the period.

period_comparison.description: Comparison metrics between current and previous time period, including changes in order count and revenue, plus a breakdown of status transitions (orders that moved between states during the period).
period_comparison.x-autobe-specification: Computed comparison between current time window and previous same-duration window: order_count_delta = current_order_count - previous_order_count; revenue_delta = current_total_revenue - previous_total_revenue. status_change_breakdown counts orders that transitioned between statuses during the period: paid_to_shipped (orders moving from paid to shipped), shipped_to_delivered (orders moving from shipped to delivered), delivered_to_refunded (orders moving from delivered to refunded), cancelled_count (orders cancelled in this period).

snapshot_at.description: Timestamp when this metrics snapshot was captured, in ISO 8601 UTC format.
snapshot_at.x-autobe-specification: Computed timestamp: Current server timestamp in ISO 8601 UTC format (e.g., 2026-03-10T11:29:16.610Z) when this metrics snapshot was captured and returned to the API consumer. Used to indicate data freshness and enable caching strategies.

IEcommerceMallOrderLifecycleMetric.description: Aggregated order lifecycle metrics for administrative monitoring and business intelligence. This schema provides a comprehensive snapshot of order processing health, including order counts by status, item quantities across fulfillment stages, revenue calculations, period-over-period comparisons, and the capture timestamp. Used by admin observability dashboards to track business trends, fulfillment rates, and operational efficiency.
IEcommerceMallOrderLifecycleMetric.x-autobe-specification:
Computed aggregation from ecommerce_mall_orders and ecommerce_mall_order_items tables. All metrics are calculated dynamically based on time window parameters:
1. order_count: COUNT(DISTINCT order.id) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL within time window
2. status_distribution: COUNT(orders) GROUP BY overall_status with filters for paid/shipped/delivered/cancelled/refunded/partiallyCompleted
3. item_metrics: SUM(order_items.quantity) GROUP BY item_status for paid/shipped/delivered/cancelled/refunded
4. price_metrics: SUM(orders.total_price) for total_revenue, AVG(orders.total_price) for average_order_value
5. period_comparison: Calculate delta between current and previous time window; status_change_breakdown tracks orders that transitioned between statuses (paid->shipped, shipped->delivered, delivered->refunded, cancelled)
6. snapshot_at: Current server timestamp when metrics were captured
All calculations exclude soft-deleted records. Timestamps normalized to ISO 8601 UTC.

cart_id.description: The shopping cart ID to synchronize.

IEcommerceMallInventoryHealthMetric.IVar.description: Summary view of a product variant with critical low stock information, including current stock level and product context for prioritized reorder planning.
IEcommerceMallInventoryHealthMetric.IVar.x-autobe-specification: Computed health metric DTO from ecommerce_mall_product_variants joined with ecommerce_mall_products. Fields: id from product_variants.id, skuCode from product_variants.sku_code, stockQuantity from product_variants.stock_quantity, productName from products.name via product relation, sellerId from products.seller_id via product relation. Filter: stock_quantity < 10 AND stock_quantity > 0. Ordered by stock_quantity ascending. This is a summary/metric view not a full entity representation.

variant_id.description: The unique identifier of the product variant to add to the cart.
variant_id.x-autobe-specification: References ecommerce_mall_product_variants.id FK column that will be stored in cart_items.variant_id. Must reference an existing active product variant. The variant's current stock level and price are validated/checked at operation time when creating the cart item record.

quantity.description: The number of variant units to add to the cart. Must be at least 1.
quantity.x-autobe-specification: Maps to cart_items.quantity column. Integer field storing the number of variants to add. Must be at least 1. If the same variant already exists in the cart, this operation increments the existing quantity by this amount (aggregate behavior).

IEcommerceMallShoppingCart.IManageOperat.description: Request body for adding a product variant to a customer's shopping cart. Specifies which variant to add and the quantity. When submitted, this operation either adds a new cart item or merges with an existing cart item for the same variant by incrementing the quantity.
IEcommerceMallShoppingCart.IManageOperat.x-autobe-specification: Request DTO for the IManageOperationAdd cart operation. This is an operation request schema (not a direct entity mapping). variant_id references an existing product variant from ecommerce_mall_product_variants.id and will be stored in cart_items.variant_id FK. quantity specifies the number of variants to add and will be stored in cart_items.quantity. The active cart context (ecommerce_mall_shopping_carts) is resolved from JWT token/actor authentication. Business rules enforced: quantity must be at least 1, variant_id must reference an existing active product variant, stock availability validated at operation time. The operation adds the variant to the customer's cart with the specified quantity, or increments quantity if the same variant already exists in the cart (aggregate behavior).

alert_type.description: Type of system health alert indicating what metric exceeded thresholds.
alert_type.x-autobe-specification: Computed alert classification: error_rate (errors exceeding threshold) or performance_degraded (performance metrics below acceptable level). Derived from audit log analysis and metric aggregation.

action_type.description: The audit action category associated with this alert.
action_type.x-autobe-specification: References the action_type field from audit log entries. Indicates which system operation or audit category triggered the health alert.

current_rate.description: The current metric value that exceeded the defined threshold.
current_rate.x-autobe-specification: The actual numeric value that triggered the alert (percentage, error count, or performance metric). Computed from real-time metric aggregation. Minimum 0.

threshold.description: The threshold value that was exceeded to trigger this alert.
threshold.x-autobe-specification: The limit that was exceeded to trigger this alert. Derived from alert configuration: 1.0 for yellow severity, 5.0 for red severity, 50.0 for performance degradation. Minimum 0.

severity.description: Severity level of the alert indicating urgency: yellow for moderate issues, red for critical issues.
severity.x-autobe-specification: Computed from current_rate vs threshold comparison: yellow for moderate exceedance (>1% of threshold), red for critical exceedance (>5% of threshold). Derived enum from alert severity rules.

message.description: Human-readable description of the alert condition, auto-generated.
message.x-autobe-specification: Auto-generated human-readable message based on alert_type, severity, and threshold exceeded. Computed at alert generation time with template: "{alert_type} exceeded threshold: {current_rate}% (threshold: {threshold}%)". Nullable if message generation fails.

timestamp.description: When the alert was triggered, in ISO 8601 UTC format.
timestamp.x-autobe-specification: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the alert was triggered. Computed from system clock at alert evaluation time. Nullable if timestamp generation fails.

IEcommerceMallSystemHealthMetric.IAlert.x-autobe-specification: Computed alert schema derived from system health monitoring aggregations. alert_type and severity are enum-derived from threshold comparisons. action_type references audit log actions. current_rate and threshold are numeric metrics from observability dashboard calculations. message and timestamp are auto-generated based on alert state. This schema does not map to a single database table.
